summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Watchlist persistence  **What I found by reading the code (no changes made):**  The chain the ticket suspects is broken actually looks correctly wired in the current codebase: - `client/src/lib/api.ts` sends `credentials: "include"` on every request — no localStorage/anonymous fallback anywhere in the watchlist client code (`WatchlistPage.tsx`). - `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` has its own auth middleware requiring a valid session and injecting `X-User-Id`; every query (list, create, read, update, delete, add/remove item) filters `WHERE user_id = ?`. - `db/auth.ts`:
